The main takeaway from our work is that

the PADUA score is a useful tool to predict the risk of complications and the change of post-operative renal function in patients undergoing laparo-scopic partial nephrectomy, and the REN-AL score is a useful predictor of postoperative renal function change.
the PADUA classification is a simple, reliable, and reproducible method for preoperatively predicting postoperative renal function in patients with renal masses.
the PADUA classification is an accurate predictor of renal function decline in patients undergoing laparo-scopic PN, which is a major determinant of long-term oncological outcome.
